name: Club Med Sinai Bay Hotel
info: Turnkey construction of 385 guestrooms, main building & reception, 6 swimming pools, 7 restaurants, buffet & main bar, spa & diving center, 7 tennis playgrounds, mini golf area, mini football playground.

name: Ancient Sands Golf Resort & Residences
info: Luxury 5-star resort featuring 281 rooms and suites integrated with championship golf course facilities. Complete resort development including restaurants, pools, and spa facilities.

name: Steigenberger Golf Resort El Gouna
info: Premium resort hotel with 375 rooms offering stunning views. Includes multiple restaurants, swimming pools, spa facilities, and direct golf course access.

name: The Cascades Golf & Spa Resort
info: Exclusive resort with 205 rooms combining luxury accommodation with championship golf. Features fine dining, wellness facilities, and private beach access.

name: Movenpick Resort El Quseir
info: Beachfront resort featuring 250 rooms with private beach, multiple pools, restaurants, diving center, and spa facilities. Complete resort infrastructure.

name: Casa Cook Hotel
info: Boutique lifestyle hotel with 13 suites, restaurant, swimming pool, and service buildings. Modern architectural design with premium finishes.

name: Hotel Renovation Project
info: Complete renovation of 66 rooms & 16 suites, 3 restaurants & 1 bar, 2 swimming pools, fitness center, spa & private beach facilities.

name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
info: Modern government complex in New Administrative Capital featuring advanced security systems, conference facilities, and sustainable design for ministerial operations.

name: Government Administrative Complex
info: Large-scale ministerial buildings accommodating multiple departments with smart building technology and energy-efficient systems.

name: Corporate Headquarters
info: Modern office complex with 20,000 sqm of premium office space, conference centers, parking facilities, and landscaped grounds.

name: O West Residential Development
info: Modern residential community with 4,200 units across 420 hectares. Features contemporary villas, townhouses, and apartments with full amenities including clubhouse and commercial area.

name: Taba Heights Villas
info: Luxury hillside villas offering breathtaking Red Sea views. 150 units with private pools, gardens, and access to beach club facilities.

name: El Gouna Residential Units
info: Premium apartments and villas development with 500+ units. Modern architecture with full resort amenities and marina access.

name: Makadi Heights Residences
info: Residential compound featuring townhouses and apartments with golf course views. Complete with community pools, parks, and retail area.

name: Industrial Park Facilities
info: Purpose-built industrial facilities with warehouses, production units, and logistics centers spanning 50,000 sqm. Built to international standards.

name: Manufacturing Complex
info: Modern manufacturing facility with advanced production lines, quality control labs, storage facilities, and administrative offices.

name: Logistics & Distribution Center
info: Strategic logistics hub with 40,000 sqm warehouse space, loading docks, modern inventory management systems, and truck parking.

name: El Gouna International School
info: Premium international school facility for 1,000+ students. Modern classrooms, science labs, sports facilities, performing arts center, and swimming pool.

name: Berlin British School
info: State-of-the-art educational campus following British curriculum. Capacity for 800 students with advanced learning facilities, sports grounds, and auditorium.

name: University Campus
info: Complete university campus development including lecture halls, laboratories, library, student housing, sports facilities, and administrative buildings.

name: El Gouna Golf Club
info: Championship 18-hole golf course designed by Gene Bates and Fred Couples. Features stunning desert landscape with premium clubhouse, pro shop, and dining facilities.

name: The Cascades Golf Course
info: Award-winning 18-hole championship course designed by Gary Player. Challenging layout with spectacular views of the Red Sea mountains and comprehensive facilities.

name: El Gouna Marina
info: State-of-the-art marina development with 200+ berths accommodating vessels up to 40 meters. Complete with clubhouse, retail, restaurants, and fine dining.

name: Abu Tig Marina
info: Iconic marina featuring 100 berths, waterfront promenade, restaurants, shops, and entertainment venues. The heart of El Gouna's vibrant lifestyle.

name: Lagoon Development
info: Artificial lagoon creation with crystal-clear water, sandy beaches, water sports facilities, and surrounding landscape development.

name: Sports Complex
info: Multi-sport facility including tennis courts, football fields, basketball courts, swimming pools, fitness center, and sports academy buildings.

name: Entertainment Center
info: Modern entertainment venue with cinema complex, bowling alley, arcade games, restaurants, and event spaces for 2,000+ guests.

name: Stadium Development
info: Professional sports stadium with 10,000 seating capacity, training facilities, locker rooms, VIP areas, and press center.

name: Hospital Facilities
info: Modern medical facility with 150 beds, emergency department, operating theaters, ICU, diagnostic centers, and outpatient clinics.

name: Desalination Plant
info: Water desalination facility producing 20,000 m³/day of potable water. Includes treatment systems, storage tanks, and distribution networks.

name: Sewage Treatment Plant
info: Advanced wastewater treatment facility processing 15,000 m³/day. Includes biological treatment, tertiary filtration, and treated water reuse for irrigation.

name: Power Station
info: Electrical power generation facility with 50MW capacity, substations, and distribution infrastructure serving entire development.

name: Water Tank Network
info: Comprehensive water storage system with elevated and ground tanks totaling 50,000 m³ capacity. Includes pumping stations and distribution networks.

name: El Gouna Roads Network
info: Complete road infrastructure including 100km of paved roads, bridges, roundabouts, street lighting, and traffic management systems.

name: O West Infrastructure
info: Comprehensive infrastructure for new city including roads, water networks, electricity grid, telecommunications, and drainage systems.

name: Makadi Heights Roads & Utilities
info: Major infrastructure project including highway construction, internal road network, utility corridors, and drainage systems for 10,000+ units.

name: Landscape Development
info: Extensive landscaping including parks, green spaces, irrigation systems, hardscape elements, and plant installation across resort areas.

name: Bridge Construction
info: Multi-lane bridge construction connecting major developments. Features modern design, pedestrian walkways, and advanced safety systems.

name: Shopping Mall
info: Modern retail complex with 150+ stores, food court, cinema, entertainment zone, and 2,000 parking spaces across 80,000 sqm.

name: Retail Promenade
info: Waterfront retail development with 50 shops, restaurants, cafes, and entertainment venues. Features open-air design and marina views.

name: Commercial Center
info: Mixed-use retail development combining shops, offices, and F&B outlets. Total area 25,000 sqm with modern amenities and ample parking.
